meta.title: Modify Conditions lets the buyer re-edit and re-send the prompt

plan.title: Modify and Resend AI Grouping Prompt

steps.note: Open an existing event with the received AI grouping response.

args.goal: On the buyer's existing event, open the Smart Grouping panel showing the AI grouping response, click Modify Conditions, edit the prompt, click the blue send icon, and verify that the prompt becomes editable and a new AI response appears.

steps.note: Perform and verify the Smart Grouping re-edit and resend flow, including the returned response.
Confirm the resulting screen has no application error or crash.
